arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one polished hand-inked cartoon game sprite by redrawing Image 1, the original SLEVEJM3 frame 000, with the clean bold black outlines, smooth cel shading and adult mermaid identity of Images 2 and 3. Image 1 exclusively controls pose, framing, character count, visible parts and facing. There are two characters at the water surface: a friendly stout dolphin upright on the left, head turned right, smiling long beak, rounded forehead, its pale belly toward the viewer and one pectoral flipper extending out to the left. An adult blonde mermaid is partly above water on the right, angled toward him with one arm bent across her chest and the other extending down to the right waterline. Preserve these silhouettes and relative scale. Mermaid: long brilliant yellow hair with cyan headband, warm peach skin, green swimsuit top, lower body hidden underwater exactly as the source. Dolphin: pale blue-gray body with a soft cream/light-gray belly, lively cartoon eye, smooth bold ink and restrained cel shading, no fur or shark teeth. Convert red/white source dithering to smooth peach skin. Add only the thin cyan-and-white water ripples seen along the bottom. Do not complete any hidden underwater body parts. Wide sprite, all contours inside canvas with a small transparent margin. Actual transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard, scenery, lettering or ground shadow.
